name: Six Repositories (10 CWE) Vulnerability Benchmark
source: Airflow, SaltStack, Gradio, Django, Ansible, WeasyPrint official release tags
match_mode_note: Standardized benchmark of 10 real-world CVE defect files across 10 CWE categories and 6 clean control files from 6 major Python open-source repositories.

labels.note: Apache Airflow DAG/Task unvalidated access (CWE-639): Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) via unvalidated task instance access
Apache Airflow CVE-2023-22887 (CWE-22): Path Traversal via unvalidated DagRun run_id parameter in directory path construction
Ansible CVE-2020-14365 (CWE-798): Hardcoded secret and sensitive credential handling in vault encryption routines
Django CVE-2022-34265 (CWE-89): SQL Injection in Trunc() and Extract() database functions via unsanitized kind / lookup_name parameters
Gradio CVE-2024-1729 (CWE-209): Information Disclosure via detailed exception tracebacks in route responses
Gradio CVE-2024-1561 / CVE-2024-1729 (CWE-79): Cross-Site Scripting via unsanitized raw HTML component rendering and component injection
SaltStack ClearFuncs CVE-2020-11651 (CWE-287): Authentication Bypass in ClearFuncs exposing privileged master methods to unauthenticated callers
SaltStack CVE-2020-16846 (CWE-78): OS Command Injection via shell=True in ssh-keygen command formatting
SaltStack CVE-2020-11651 (CWE-502 / CWE-287): Insecure Deserialization of unauthenticated ZeroMQ message loads
WeasyPrint CVE-2023-24816 (CWE-918): Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via arbitrary URL fetching and redirection
